full_prompt_en: A square sculptural digital artwork shows an elaborate cream-and-coral form floating above a light grey floor against a smooth taupe background. The lower half resembles a voluminous dress made of tightly gathered ruffles. Broad folds open towards the right, while smaller, densely packed ripples accumulate underneath and along the left edge. Thin ivory ridges catch the light above warm grey creases, giving the layered material a soft, fibrous, finely crumpled appearance. Above this skirt-like mass, irregular cream and pink-red clusters curve upwards around open gaps. Their broken, granular surfaces suggest small blossoms or crumb-like fragments without resolving into a clearly defined material. Several larger clusters remain joined by narrow curling forms, while tiny detached pieces scatter around the upper and side edges. A high curved extension rises on the right and bends back towards the centre; another fragment-rich extension reaches towards the upper left. Red and coral accents are concentrated through the upper structure and across the top of the pale lower mass. The overall outline loosely suggests a figure in a swirling dress, but no distinct face, hands or anatomically defined limbs are visible. A clear gap separates the lowest ruffles from the floor. Below them, a soft-edged brown shadow extends well to the left, while the floor on the right is brighter. Broad illumination from the upper-right front picks out the cream folds and granular edges, leaving deeper grey-brown recesses within the mass. The backdrop has a subdued smooth gradient and very little detail. Dense tactile folds, airy broken upper forms and a long low shadow balance the suspended shape against generous surrounding space.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形雕塑感数字作品，繁复的奶油白与珊瑚色形体悬浮于浅灰地面上方，背景为平滑灰褐色。下半部像由密集褶裥组成的蓬松裙摆，宽大褶层向右展开，更小、更紧密的波纹堆积在底部与左边缘。纤薄象牙白凸脊在暖灰折痕上方接住亮光，使层叠材料呈现柔软纤维感与细密揉皱质地。裙摆状团块上方，不规则奶油色与粉红簇状结构绕着空隙向上弯曲。破碎颗粒表面近似小花或碎屑，但没有明确指向某一种材质。较大团簇通过狭窄卷曲结构相连，细小独立碎片散落在上部与两侧边缘。右侧一段较高弯曲结构升起后折回中央，另一段布满碎片的延伸形体伸向左上。红色与珊瑚色集中于上部结构及浅色下部团块的顶部。整体外轮廓隐约像穿着旋动裙装的人形，但没有清楚面孔、手或明确解剖结构的四肢。最低处褶层与地面之间留有清晰空隙。下方柔边棕色阴影明显向左延伸，右侧地面更明亮。来自右前上方的宽阔亮光突出奶油白褶皱和颗粒边缘，使团块内部保留较深灰棕凹部。背景渐变含蓄，几乎没有其他细节。密集触感褶层、轻盈破碎的上部形体与低长投影，使悬浮主体在宽阔空处中取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The style combines soft sculptural volume, finely layered ripples and irregular granular edges. Ivory and cream dominate, with coral-red accents concentrated in denser upper areas and warm grey-brown shades inside recesses. Broad light catches thin ridges and translucent-looking edges, while subtle occlusion gives the tightly overlapping layers depth. Larger connected masses break into scattered small fragments around their perimeter. A smooth neutral background, a pale supporting plane and a soft elongated shadow separate the detailed volume from its surroundings. The composition balances dense texture with generous negative space and an airy, suspended quality.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格结合柔和雕塑体积、细密层叠波纹与不规则颗粒边缘。象牙白和奶油白占主导，珊瑚红强调集中于较密集的上部区域，暖灰棕色留在内部凹陷。宽阔光线照亮薄脊与近似半透明的边缘，细微遮蔽暗部赋予紧密重叠的层次以纵深。较大相连团块在外围分解为散落小碎片。平滑中性背景、浅色承托平面与柔和长影，将细节丰富的体积从周围空间中分离出来。构图以充足留白平衡密集肌理，呈现轻盈悬浮感。
theme_en: A floating pale ruffled form with scattered coral fragments
theme_zh: 漂浮的浅色褶皱形体与散落珊瑚碎屑
name: Shinichi Maruyama
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
